name: The Troll Witchdoctor
summary: Nazeer Bloodpike seeks the truth about Marg Nighteye's death through troll witch-magic. You carry Marg's head to Kin'weelay at Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

sections.title: Witch-Magic of the Trolls
sections.body: Nazeer Bloodpike insists the truth about Marg's death must come to light. He says only troll witch-magic can reveal what happened. So you carry Marg's head to Kin'weelay at Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale. No Darkspear witchdoctor is mightier than Kin'weelay, and Nazeer believes Kin'weelay can reach Marg's spirit.

sections.title: Words at Grom'gol
sections.body: At Grom'gol, Kin'weelay senses an angry spirit. The witchdoctor studies the head and sees that the orc's spirit remains bound to this world. It rages over a duty left undone. Kin'weelay proposes to speak with it.

faq.q: Why must Marg Nighteye's head be taken to Stranglethorn Vale?
faq.answer: Nazeer Bloodpike says only troll witch-magic can reveal what happened around Marg Nighteye's death. Kin'weelay is at Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.
Kin'weelay is the mightiest witchdoctor among the Darkspear trolls. Kin'weelay can be found at Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.
